scope: Overall health-related sentiment across Michigan communities, eight health topics, and four simulated source categories. Not a Corewell or hospital review dashboard.
method: Seeded fixture generator with assigned sentiment scores. 9,400 general-health records and 120 records per event. No actual posts, testimony, search metrics, or patient data.

events.label: Air quality advisory
events.title: Air quality concerns enter the health conversation.
events.description: An illustrative air quality advisory prompts concerns about respiratory symptoms, outdoor work, and access to clean indoor spaces.
events.response: Residents are concerned about respiratory health and safe outdoor activity after an illustrative air quality advisory.
events.note: Entire event and all associated responses are illustrative, not actual reported events.

events.label: Coverage disruption
events.title: Affordability shapes access to care.
events.description: An illustrative insurance coverage disruption raises concerns about out-of-pocket costs, prescription access, and delayed care.
events.response: An illustrative coverage disruption is prompting concerns about medical bills and prescription affordability.
events.note: Entire event and all associated responses are illustrative, not actual reported events.

events.label: Mental health access
events.title: More ways to reach mental health support.
events.description: An illustrative expansion of community mental health appointments creates a positive moment around timely support and access.
events.response: An illustrative expansion of community mental health appointments is a welcome improvement in access to support.
events.note: Entire event and all associated responses are illustrative, not actual reported events.

events.label: Community screening
events.title: Prevention meets the neighborhood.
events.description: An illustrative mobile screening program brings preventive care closer to neighborhoods and workplaces.
events.response: An illustrative mobile screening program makes preventive care easier to reach in the community.
events.note: Entire event and all associated responses are illustrative, not actual reported events.

events.label: Corewell ER staffing
events.title: A reported staffing change adds to the wider health conversation.
events.description: Corewell Health reportedly plans to outsource ER staffing at Troy, Grosse Pointe and Lenox to TeamHealth, a private equity-backed firm. Livonia was described as likely.
events.response: The reported Corewell ER staffing plan raises concerns about continuity, workload, and clinician autonomy.
events.note: Reported planned outsourcing; not independently confirmed here. Publication date, not a verified implementation date. All responses are simulated.
